	def deleteZeroCounterEvents(paramsDict):
		'''
			Executes the zero counterEvent cleanup stored procedure
			Args:
				paramsDict (dict)
				- olderThanMinutes (int, optional): Only delete counterEvent rows older than this many minutes
			Returns:
				deletedCount (int)
			Updated:
				jfc 04/21/26 1:00pm: Created
		'''
		dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('core')
		
		olderThanMinutes = paramsDict['olderThanMinutes'] if paramsDict.has_key('olderThanMinutes') else 60
		
		call = system.db.createSProcCall('[mes].[spDeleteZeroCounterEvents]', dbName)
		call.registerInParam('olderThanMinutes', system.db.INTEGER, olderThanMinutes)
		call.registerOutParam('deletedCount', system.db.INTEGER)
		
		system.db.execSProcCall(call)
		
		deletedCount = call.getOutParamValue('deletedCount')
		return deletedCount
